targets.query:
import "array"

_acRec    = from(bucket: v.defaultBucket) |> range(start: -2m) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sungrow" and r["_field"] == "total_active_power")  |> last() |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)
_battRec  = from(bucket: v.defaultBucket) |> range(start: -2m) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sungrow" and r["_field"] == "battery_power")         |> last() |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)
_gridRec  = from(bucket: v.defaultBucket) |> range(start: -2m) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sungrow" and r["_field"] == "export_power_hybrid")    |> last() |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)
acPower   = if exists _acRec._value   then _acRec._value   else 0.0
battPower = if exists _battRec._value then _battRec._value else 0.0
gridPower = if exists _gridRec._value then _gridRec._value else 0.0

pvPower = acPower + battPower

battDischarge = if battPower < 0.0 then -battPower else 0.0
battCharge    = if battPower > 0.0 then battPower else 0.0
gridImport    = if gridPower < 0.0 then -gridPower else 0.0
gridExport    = if gridPower > 0.0 then gridPower else 0.0

battToGrid  = if battDischarge < gridExport then battDischarge else gridExport
gridToBatt  = if battCharge    < gridImport then battCharge    else gridImport
pvToBatt    = battCharge    - gridToBatt
pvToGrid    = gridExport    - battToGrid
battToHouse = battDischarge - battToGrid
gridToHouse = gridImport    - gridToBatt
pvToHouse   = pvPower       - pvToBatt - pvToGrid

array.from(rows: [
  {Quelle: "PV Solar",  Ziel: "Haus",         "Leistung (W)": if pvToHouse   > 0.0 then pvToHouse   else 0.0},
  {Quelle: "PV Solar",  Ziel: "Batterie",     "Leistung (W)": if pvToBatt    > 0.0 then pvToBatt    else 0.0},
  {Quelle: "PV Solar",  Ziel: "Einspeisung",  "Leistung (W)": if pvToGrid    > 0.0 then pvToGrid    else 0.0},
  {Quelle: "Batterie",  Ziel: "Haus",         "Leistung (W)": if battToHouse > 0.0 then battToHouse else 0.0},
  {Quelle: "Batterie",  Ziel: "Einspeisung",  "Leistung (W)": if battToGrid  > 0.0 then battToGrid  else 0.0},
  {Quelle: "Netz",      Ziel: "Haus",         "Leistung (W)": if gridToHouse > 0.0 then gridToHouse else 0.0},
  {Quelle: "Netz",      Ziel: "Batterie",     "Leistung (W)": if gridToBatt  > 0.0 then gridToBatt  else 0.0},
])

panels.title: Wind Rose (origin)
panels.description: Frequency of wind by origin direction and speed. The compass shows where the wind comes FROM, not where it is going.

targets.query:
direction = from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "weather")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "winddir")

speed = from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "weather")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "windspeed")

union(tables: [direction, speed])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> rename(columns: {winddir: "wind_direction", windspeed: "wind_speed"})
  |> yield(name: "wind_data")
